items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: We played Buckeye Lake, down near where what'cha-call-him comes from, Sol(?)...

ctx.x: So you still have the band, and...

So we got our money, and then we left and we went down to Ohio. We played Buckeye Lake, down near where what'cha-call-him comes from, Sol(?)... And we had a piano player with us then. Because Teddy flipped, you know. Teddy flipped the night that Joe Louis won the championship. We played at the (?) in Chicago that night. And I had to get another piano player. That's Gabby(?). I don't know what Gabby's(?) last name was. Does that ring a bell to you?
